{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now compute the mean of biomarker_final in ng/mL
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f'Mean biomarker_final (ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final}')"}
